Example annotation table

Source: R/annotation_table.R
annotation_table.Rd

Annotation of the barcodes of count_table, an example loss-of-function shRNA screen. Each row describes one shRNA (barcode) and the gene it targets. Use it together with count_table to create a ScreenR object with create_screenr_object.

Usage

data(annotation_table)

Format

A data frame with 5320 rows (barcodes) and 5 columns:

Gene

The name of the gene targeted by the shRNA.

Barcode

The barcode identifier, unique for each shRNA. It links the annotation table to the count table.

Gene_ID

A gene identifier (NA in this example).

Sequence

The sequence of the shRNA (NA in this example).

Library

The library of the shRNA, a pooled library from Cellecta (NA in this example).

See also

count_table, create_screenr_object

Examples

data(annotation_table)
head(annotation_table)
#>       Gene Barcode Gene_ID Sequence Library
#> 1 Gene_380   10208      NA       NA      NA
#> 2 Gene_380   10502      NA       NA      NA
#> 3 Gene_380   10796      NA       NA      NA
#> 4 Gene_380   11089      NA       NA      NA
#> 5 Gene_380   11382      NA       NA      NA
#> 6 Gene_380   11675      NA       NA      NA
